limitations: Archive pages 1–19 expose 380 titles. Page 20 redirects to login; access controls were not bypassed.
The public index exposes titles but often no individual article URLs or exact dates. It may lag the account; the cutoff is a search cutoff, not proof of coverage through that day.
Direct WeChat article access required verification. Independently indexed, explicitly attributed reposts were also searched.
Descriptor-only matches are marked as inferences. Ambiguous titles remain unresolved rather than being assigned a guessed paper.
General robotics, video-generation and industry-commentary posts without an established driving research connection are outside this catalog.

policy.identity: Deduplicate by arXiv identifier, primary-paper URL and normalized title, including renamed methods.
policy.facts: Verify titles, publication dates, methods and release status using arXiv, publishers, authors and official repositories.
policy.code: Repository existence alone is not a released implementation. Pending can lack an announced repository URL; partial releases identify available components.
policy.dates: published records first public paper month when verified; venue records later formal publication only when supported by primary sources.
